description: This is a test module implementing end-to-end tests for gap analysis and development plan generation in a career platform backend API. It defines test functions that simulate user authentication, role and competency setup, gap analysis, and development plan creation via API calls.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] _auth_headers(client)
methods.description: Generates authentication headers by registering and logging in a test user, returning a Bearer token.

methods.name: test_gap_analysis_and_plan_generation(client, db_session)
methods.description: Performs an end-to-end test of gap analysis and development plan generation via API endpoints, including setup of roles and competencies, gap analysis, and plan export.
